Class RuleProposalService

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.udffill.ai.RuleProposalService
@Service public class RuleProposalService extends Object
The language model proposes a template rule from the existing values of a field; the instance evaluates the rule from then on. The user first sees exactly which values would be sent, may deselect some, and only then the request goes out — one round, no tools. The answer is parsed and evaluated against all values of the field like the test of a rule. The model never writes a value, and nothing is stored apart from the request log.
